site.name: Pathwoven
site.tagline: Short choice-driven stories you can finish in one sitting.

stories.title: Forrest Path
stories.blurb: Greenbow to Vietnam to the open road. Longer scenes, harder forks—stay true for the film's ending, or step into other lives. Twelve endings.
stories.contentNotes: Inspired by Forrest Gump. Bittersweet themes: war, illness, grief.

stories.title: Three Kingdoms: Banner
stories.blurb: Late Han collapses. Choose Wei, Shu, or Wu, then ride fever, fire, debt, and winter through Red Cliffs and the wars after. Nine endings; longer scenes.
stories.contentNotes: Based on Chinese history and Romance of the Three Kingdoms traditions (public domain). War, loyalty, and alternate outcomes.

stories.title: Maskward City
stories.blurb: Fog-locked Maskward hides Masked citizens behind human faces. Elias banks Residue to stay alive, then chooses Compass, Lattice, or Ash Circlet before Crimson Fog Week. Nine endings.
stories.contentNotes: Original fiction. Mild horror: disguised predators, civic violence, moral compromise.
